run_main_training: run the main training pipeline for SeLaVi video-audio self-supervised learning with distributed mode
train_epoch: train the SeLaVi model for one epoch using video and audio features with Sinkhorn-Knopp clustering
parse_arguments: parse command-line arguments for SeLaVi distributed training configuration
load_model: load a SeLaVi video-audio dual-branch model with configurable backbone architectures
cluster_selflabels: cluster selflabels using Sinkhorn-Knopp optimization for self-supervised video-audio learning
